skill_name: Summarize this article about eating disorders.
workflow: Eating disorders are mental health conditions that affect the way individuals perceive their body, weight and food. The three main types of eating disorders are anorexia nervosa, bulimia, and binge eating. Individuals with anorexia have an intense fear of gaining weight and restrict caloric intake, those with bulimia engage in binge eating followed by purging, and those suffering from binge eating disorder eat large amounts of food even when not physically hungry.
